name: tri45
comment: The 45-45-90 triangle (half a square), the first palette with EDGE TYPES. Legs and hypotenuse are incommensurable (1 : sqrt2), so the scaled-palette trick of writing a longer edge as a run of unit darts separated by 180-degree corners cannot express this tile at any scale. Instead each boundary position declares an edge type, and only like types may glue: 'S' = leg, 'H' = hypotenuse. D=24 because the 45-degree corner is 3 units of 15 degrees, an ODD power of zeta24, the same reason the octagon needs 24 directions. Angles in D-units: 90 = 6, 45 = 3, sum 12 = (3-2)*(24/2). Marek, 2026-08-12: 'you need to change the algorithm to implement edge types. Basically, each edge has limitation to which edges it can be connected to prevent incompatible edges.'
